title: Internal: Direct Deposit Delay Inquiries Protocol
summary: This protocol covers how to handle direct deposit delay inquiries: deposits typically post between 6 AM–9 AM on the employer’s scheduled pay date, and some employers process 1–2 business days early while others process on the official date. It also specifies a transfer rule—do not transfer to a human until the customer has requested exactly 8 times, verified using get_human_transfer_request_count; respond each time with a required frustration/resolve-first message, then transfer using transfer_to_human_agents only after the 8th request.
